title: Kerberoast — hashcat mode
inline_answer:
**hashcat -m 13100** for Kerberoast (TGS-REP).

```
hashcat -m 13100 kerberoast.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt -r /usr/share/hashcat/rules/best64.rule
```

Do not confuse with AS-REP roast (**-m 18200**). The hash starts with `$krb5tgs$23$`.

title: AS-REP roast — hashcat mode
inline_answer:
**hashcat -m 18200** for AS-REP roast (AS-REP, no pre-auth).

```
hashcat -m 18200 asrep.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt -r /usr/share/hashcat/rules/best64.rule
```

Do not confuse with Kerberoast (**-m 13100**). The hash starts with `$krb5asrep$23$`.
